specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square albedo texture for terrain in a polished low-poly desert city-building game, intended to work at street level and at isometric distance. Generate a single 1024x1024 square material swatch filling the entire image. Straight overhead orthographic material scan, not an isometric tile or scene. Warm Nevada desert sand and finely compacted sandy earth, occasional tiny sandstone grains and soft small wind-swept variations. Match a restrained warm tan palette centered on sRGB #C2A279, with subtle warmer ochre and pale sandstone grains; broad low-frequency variations limited to roughly ten percent, fine detail quiet. Stylized painterly realism suitable for clean low-poly geometry, not noisy photographic grit. Even neutral diffuse illumination, pure base color, no baked directional light, shadows, ambient occlusion, highlights or height illusion. Seamlessly tileable on BOTH axes, opposing edges matching, equal density at edges and center, no border. No dunes, large stones, vegetation, tire tracks, footprints, buildings, symbols, writing, logos, frame, vignette, patchwork, perspective or transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square albedo texture for rocky sloped terrain in a polished low-poly Nevada desert city-building game. Generate a single 1024x1024 square material swatch filling the entire image. Straight overhead orthographic material scan, not an isometric tile, cliff scene or illustration. Compact weathered sandstone ground with sparse small angular flat rock chips and fine sandy gravel; restrained irregular mineral strata and worn cracks, mostly sandy matrix. Colors stay close to warm tan sRGB #C2A279, with dusty sandstone #AA8865 and muted pale beige #CFB18B. Low contrast so it blends naturally with warm fine desert sand. Painterly stylized realism suitable for low-poly geometry, enough material detail at street level while unobtrusive at isometric distance. Even neutral diffuse illumination, pure base color, no baked directional lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion or specular highlights. Seamlessly tileable on BOTH axes, opposing edges matching, equal density at edges and center. Avoid large recognizably repeated boulders, deep dark fissures, stripes, dunes, plants, roads, perspective, icons, lettering, borders, vignette, transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square asphalt albedo texture for roads in a polished low-poly desert city-building game. Generate one 1024x1024 square swatch covering the whole image. Perfectly overhead orthographic material scan, not a scene or isometric tile. Clean worn charcoal blue-gray asphalt, average sRGB #566166, small finely crushed aggregate and a very light dusting of warm Nevada desert sand in minute pores. Keep low contrast and fine detail: a smooth readable road at isometric distance, subtle tactile aggregate at street level. Painterly stylized realism, controlled non-photographic grain. Pure base color under uniform neutral diffuse lighting; no baked shadows, occlusion, glare, shine, directional light or height illusion. Seamlessly tileable on BOTH axes with matching opposite edges, no edge border and no center feature. NO painted lane markings, stripes, curbs, sidewalk, road boundaries, potholes, prominent cracks, tire marks, plants, text, labels, logos, grid, vignette, perspective or transparency.
